# Fenris claw

Type: Material | Internal ID: WolfClaw | Source: Frost Caves | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Fenris claw can only be found in Frost Caves in the Mountain biome.
Fenris claws are not dropped by enemies in Frost Caves, but instead are found atop mysterious pedestals located within the dungeons.

### Building

• Standing brazier

### Crafting

• Flesh rippers

Categorias: Materials
